text: Before you take payment from a member, take ten seconds to check the bill. Covered services should be free, and member prices applied.
Remember: covered lines say covered, and a member never gets two discounts on one line.
A heart on a line means it's for a member pet.
Each covered line says covered. The wellness visit, rabies, the heartworm test, and the sharps disposal that comes with the vaccine are all part of Maple's plan.
The sick visit isn't included, but Maple's plan takes fifty percent off extra exams. The line shows the member discount.
If the household also has a discount, like a senior discount, Scout uses whichever is bigger. Never both.
The totals show what the membership covered today. What Maria pays is just the sick visit.
If the pet joined after the charges were added, prices won't have changed yet. Use Reprice before you take payment.

The most common mistakes: typing over a member price by hand, and taking payment before repricing a brand-new member. Remember: covered lines say covered, and a member never gets two discounts on one line.
